title: Fast LapSum: Exact Differentiable Top-$k$ at Million Scale
abstract: arXiv:2608.06912v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Selecting the top-$k$ elements is a fundamental operation for inducing sparsity in large-scale models and optimization problems, enabling robust expert activation, token routing or attention pruning. However, hard top-$k$ is non-differentiable, while existing differentiable alternatives become increasingly expensive as the number of coordinates grows. We introduce Fast LapSum, a scalable solver for the LapSum soft top-$k$ formulation that preserves an exact selection mass of $k$, while supporting end-to-end differentiation. In Fast LapSum, we reduce sorting cost using probabilistic bracketing, which restricts sorting to a narrow band of scores around the threshold using a binomial order-statistic from kernel-noised samples. A certification pass upgrades the probabilistic localization to a verified one at the cost of one additional linear pass, with a full-sort fallback that covers the worst-case scenario. translated_title: 快速 LapSum：百万规模下的精确可微分 Top-$k$ 运算
translated_abstract: 选择 top-$k$ 元素是在大规模模型和优化问题中诱导稀疏性的一项基础操作，可用于实现鲁棒的专家激活、token 路由或注意力剪枝。然而，硬性 top-$k$ 运算不可微分，而现有的可微分替代方法会随着坐标数量的增长而变得愈发昂贵。我们提出了 Fast LapSum，这是一种针对 LapSum 软 top-$k$ 公式化的可扩展求解器，它在保持精确选择质量 $k$ 的同时，支持端到端微分。在 Fast LapSum 中，我们通过概率区间限定来降低排序成本，该方法利用从核噪声样本中获得的二项式顺序统计量，将排序限制在阈值附近的一个狭窄分数区间内。一次认证遍历以额外一次线性遍历的代价，将概率定位升级为经过验证的定位，并配有覆盖最坏情况的全排序回退机制。我们的认证 GPU 实现……
tldr: Fast LapSum 通过概率区间限定与认证遍历将排序成本限制在阈值附近的窄区间内，实现了百万规模下保持精确选择质量且支持端到端微分的高效可微 top-k 求解。
en_tdlr: Fast LapSum enables exact, differentiable top-k selection at million scale by restricting sorting to a narrow band around the threshold via probabilistic bracketing with a certification pass, while preserving exact selection mass and supporting end-to-end differentiation.
